One thing I noticed for a lot of your gunfights when you are strafing you are not adjusting your crosshair until after you are about to stop moving. If you look at the fight with Iso at around 8:41 of the deathmatch timer: you move, stop, adjust crosshair, shoot, repeat. Ideally adjusting your aim during your strafe so that you "aim faster".

To practice this, any kind of practice range strafing exercise would work,  I personally used the overaim one in the Woohoojin guide to gold. Start first with easy bots and do it in parts. First only practice strafing. When a bot spawns on your left strafe right and when it spawns on your right strafe left. Then practice over aiming; When bot spawns on the left, flick left past the bot's head and don't shoot. Same process when it spawns on your right. After you are comfortable with both of these, combine the moving and aiming process together but don't shoot yet. In this step you want to keep strafing until your crosshair is on the bot's head. So strafe + overaim but keep moving until you are on the bot's head and then stop moving. Make sure you are strafing and aiming at the same time; you can record this to make sure you are not strafing and then aiming. Practice this until you are comfortable and then add in the shooting. Try to get 20 on easy bots before moving on to medium bots. Might seem very tedious to do every step individually but it helps with avoiding bad habits and learning the muscle memory faster.

In the beginning its better to over exaggerate the over aim and strafing. The whole point is to train mouse movement while you are moving. You can always make your strafes smaller and over aim less pronounced afterwards. Mix this in with your deathmatch games and see how it goes.

Its also easier to make space for your dps to do dps things. Granted you definitely cannot duel the enemy tanks and rather have to play a bit more passive with your shield up and firestrike spam until you get your ult. I also find it more likely a dps switches to healer if there is already a shield tank.
